name: Open at Any Page
tagline: Four oversized question tabs let visitors choose where to begin.
typography: Baskerville headlines and Avenir Next navigation.
rationale: The visual centerpiece is the page index itself. Each coloured tab answers a real visitor question and carries the same surface into its destination.
mobile: The tabs become a two-by-two grid, followed by the same four sections in page order.
supporting: Each tab leads to a complete section and Contact is reachable directly from the opening screen.
trust: Plain-language labels and a verified appointment route clarify how the personal site relates to the clinic.
seo: The questions and answers are visible HTML and all destinations use ordinary links.
accessibility: Tab labels provide meaning independently of colour. Links and native disclosures are keyboard operable.
tradeoff: The question grid is intentionally prominent. Keep the approved answers short and specific so the page stays easy to scan.
